name: @activepieces/piece-slite
description: Slite is a modern knowledge base. Create, search, update, and ask questions about your team docs.

auth.description:
**Authenticate with your Slite API key.**

1. Open your organization menu at the top-left of the Slite app.
2. Go to **Settings → API**.
3. Click **Create a new key** and follow the steps.
4. Copy the key (it is shown only once) and paste it here.

ask_question.name: ask_question
ask_question.description: Asks a question in natural language and returns an answer drawn from your Slite docs, with sources.

question.description: The question to ask your Slite knowledge base.

parent_note_id.description: Limit the answer to docs nested under this parent.

auth.description:
**Authenticate with your Slite API key.**

1. Open your organization menu at the top-left of the Slite app.
2. Go to **Settings → API**.
3. Click **Create a new key** and follow the steps.
4. Copy the key (it is shown only once) and paste it here.

aiMetadata.description: Runs Slite's AskX over the workspace knowledge base, returning a natural-language answer synthesized from indexed docs along with the source docs it drew from. Choose this for question-answering or retrieval over team docs rather than keyword lookup; optionally scope the answer to docs nested under a given parent doc id. Read-only and idempotent: repeating the same question produces the same answer for the current index state.

create_doc.name: create_doc
create_doc.description: Creates a doc inside a parent doc or your private channel.

title.description: The title of the new doc.

parent_note_id.description: Where to create the new doc. Leave blank to create it in your private channel.

auth.description:
**Authenticate with your Slite API key.**

1. Open your organization menu at the top-left of the Slite app.
2. Go to **Settings → API**.
3. Click **Create a new key** and follow the steps.
4. Copy the key (it is shown only once) and paste it here.

content_format.description: How the content above is written.

template_id.description: Apply a template to the new doc by its ID.

attributes.description: Attributes for the parent collection, ordered by column. Ignored if they don't match the column type.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new Slite doc with the given title and optional body, placed under a parent doc id or, if no parent is given, in the caller's private channel. Content may be supplied as Markdown or HTML, and a template can be applied by id. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate doc even with identical input.

fetch_sub_docs.name: fetch_sub_docs
fetch_sub_docs.description: Returns the list of sub docs nested under a parent doc.

note_id.description: The doc whose sub docs you want to list.

auth.description:
**Authenticate with your Slite API key.**

1. Open your organization menu at the top-left of the Slite app.
2. Go to **Settings → API**.
3. Click **Create a new key** and follow the steps.
4. Copy the key (it is shown only once) and paste it here.

aiMetadata.description: Lists the child docs nested directly under a given parent doc id in Slite, paging through all children. Use it to enumerate the contents of a collection or folder doc when you have its id. Read-only and idempotent.

replace_doc.name: replace_doc
replace_doc.description: Replaces the entire content and/or title of a doc. Fields you leave blank are kept unchanged.

note_id.description: Start typing to search your docs by title.

auth.description:
**Authenticate with your Slite API key.**

1. Open your organization menu at the top-left of the Slite app.
2. Go to **Settings → API**.
3. Click **Create a new key** and follow the steps.
4. Copy the key (it is shown only once) and paste it here.

title.description: A new title for the doc.

content.description: New content that replaces the entire doc body.

content_format.description: How the content above is written.

attributes.description: Attributes for the parent collection, ordered by column.

aiMetadata.description: Overwrites an existing Slite doc identified by its note id, replacing the whole body (Markdown or HTML) and/or the title; omitted fields are left untouched. Use this for a full-content rewrite rather than a targeted block edit (see Update Doc for that). Idempotent: applying the same input to the same doc id leaves it in the same final state.

index_askx_object.name: index_askx_object
index_askx_object.description: Sends an object to be indexed by AskX for your custom source. Note: Slite has deprecated this endpoint.

root_id.description: The root ID of your custom data source (created in Slite).

object_id.description: A unique identifier for this object within the source.

type.description: How the content above is written.

updated_at.description: When the object was last modified.

url.description: The redirect URL for the object.

aiMetadata.description: Upserts a single object (title plus Markdown or HTML content) into a custom AskX data source so it becomes searchable by Ask Question, keyed by the source's root id and the object's own id. Note: Slite has deprecated this endpoint. Idempotent: re-sending the same root id and object id overwrites that indexed entry rather than adding a duplicate.

fetch_doc.name: fetch_doc
fetch_doc.description: Returns a readable doc by its ID.

note_id.description: Start typing to search your docs by title.

auth.description:
**Authenticate with your Slite API key.**

1. Open your organization menu at the top-left of the Slite app.
2. Go to **Settings → API**.
3. Click **Create a new key** and follow the steps.
4. Copy the key (it is shown only once) and paste it here.

format.description: The format to return the doc content in.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves a single Slite doc by its note id, returning its content in the requested format (Markdown, HTML, or SliteML). Use it when you already have a doc id and need to read its body. Read-only and idempotent.

search_docs.name: search_docs
search_docs.description: Performs a keyword search across the docs you have access to.

parent_note_id.description: Limit results to docs nested under this parent.

auth.description:
**Authenticate with your Slite API key.**

1. Open your organization menu at the top-left of the Slite app.
2. Go to **Settings → API**.
3. Click **Create a new key** and follow the steps.
4. Copy the key (it is shown only once) and paste it here.

hits_per_page.description: How many results to return per page (1–100).

page.description: Which page of results to return (starts at 0).

aiMetadata.description: Runs a keyword search across the Slite docs the connected account can access, with optional scoping to a parent doc id, inclusion of archived docs, and pagination. Use this for term/title matching to locate docs and their ids; for natural-language question answering use Ask Question instead. Read-only and idempotent.

update_doc.name: update_doc
update_doc.description: Updates a specific part (tile) of a doc. Fields you leave blank are kept unchanged.

note_id.description: Start typing to search your docs by title.

auth.description:
**Authenticate with your Slite API key.**

1. Open your organization menu at the top-left of the Slite app.
2. Go to **Settings → API**.
3. Click **Create a new key** and follow the steps.
4. Copy the key (it is shown only once) and paste it here.

tile_id.description: The block to update. In Slite, hover an empty line, open its menu, and choose "Copy block id".

title.description: New header text for the tile.

content.description: New Markdown content for the tile.

url.description: An external link for the tile.

icon_url.description: An icon to display on the tile.

status_label.description: Text for the tile status badge.

status_color.description: Status badge color as a hex code, e.g. #2F80ED.

aiMetadata.description: Edits a single tile (content block) within a Slite doc, identified by the note id plus the tile id, optionally setting its header, Markdown content, link, icon, and status badge; omitted fields stay unchanged. Choose this for a targeted block-level edit rather than rewriting the whole doc (see Replace Doc for that); the tile id must be copied from the block in Slite. Idempotent: applying the same input to the same tile yields the same final state.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

pt.Slite is a modern knowledge base. Create: Slite is a modern knowledge base. Create, search, update, and ask questions about your team docs.
pt.\n**Authenticate with your Slite API key:
**Authenticate with your Slite API key.**

1. Open your organization menu at the top-left of the Slite app.
2. Go to **Settings → API**.
3. Click **Create a new key** and follow the steps.
4. Copy the key (it is shown only once) and paste it here.
